Q: Why does kafka wants data to be binary (array of bytess) in topics? A:

You're a shipper, then you should only care about the traffic, amigo!
In fact, binary is the most basic nature data using in transfer, and in producer/consumer you can write the serializer/deserializer yourself

Q: How flash 8 brush worked? A:

Find enclosing rectangle of input mouse points

If enc rect wider than high, order points by x value

Else order points by y value

Connect ordered points with a line.

For each point draw a line of brush width centered on the point at 90 degrees to line from previous point

For each point draw a line of brush width centered on the point at 90 degrees to line to next point

Join up the end points of the brush width points. ( Use the technique describer here https://stackoverflow.com/a/79696285/16582 )

Q: What is the difference between JavaScript find() and filter() methods? A:

Have you inspected what product and filteredProducts look like?

Besides that, the documentation answers your question:

The find() method of Array instances returns the first element in the provided array that satisfies the provided testing function. If no values satisfy the testing function, undefined is returned.
[...]
If you need to find all elements that satisfy the provided testing function, use filter().

Q: How to configure TLS and cipher suites when using ssl bundles? A:

Just to add how ciphers can be configured via YAML for TLS bundles. Look at the options keyword inside the yaml below:

spring:
  ssl:
    bundle:
      jks:
        foo:
          protocol: TLS
          options:
            ciphers: ECDHE_ECDSA_AES128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
            enabled-protocols: TLSv1.3

As a side note, please be aware that the list of configured ciphers may be longer than the cipher list provided by your tool. If you configure only RSA keys, the server will not present you with ciphers that contain ECDSA, only with RSA ciphers.
